chunks.title: British International Investment (BII — UK) (BII) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: British International Investment (BII — UK) is a Bilateral DFI headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Co-launched '10by30' ($10B emerging markets climate finance coalition) at COP31 on Nov 13 with Norfund & FinDev Canada. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Co-delivering $10B (€10B) '10by30' emerging markets climate finance by 2030 via British Climate Partners (shared pipeline & DD). Source verification: https://hapakenya.com/2026/11/13/uk-norway-canada-launch-10b-climate-finance-partnership-at-cop31/.

chunks.title: BII Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: British International Investment (BII — UK) provides the following climate financing instruments: Direct Equity, Senior/Mezzanine Debt, Intermediated Fund Investment, Blended Concessional Finance, Technical Assistance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 250,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: BII Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by British International Investment (BII — UK): Renewable Energy, Electrification & Grid, Energy Storage, Sustainable Fuels, Industrial Decarbonization, Climate Adaptation & Resilience. Target geographic focus includes: Africa, South Asia, Asia-Pacific, Caribbean. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: BII Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete BII's application form: 10by30 harmonized DFI climate reporting & avoided emissions methodology; BII Policy on Responsible Investing (IFC Performance Standards); UK FCDO priority emerging market eligibility (Africa, Asia, Caribbean); Private capital mobilization & commercial viability. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal, oil, unabated fossil-fuel generation. Official application portal: https://www.bii.co.uk/en/work-with-us/.

chunks.title: BII Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: British International Investment (BII — UK) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
